synthesis

Grow thick shells with excess precursor at 70 °C

Heat the excess-precursor belt mixture at 70 °C. The reported orange and red color changes mark observed progress; they are not independently specified stopping criteria. Missing fields for this phase: exact charges/volumes, heating vessel.
